title: Orthogonality of Normalized Hermite Polynomials
statement:
For all natural numbers $j,k$, the normalized Hermite polynomials $H_j,H_k$ satisfy
\[
\int_{\mathbb R}H_j(x)H_k(x)\,d\gamma(x)=\begin{cases}1,&j=k,\\0,&j\ne k,\end{cases}
\]
where $\gamma$ is the standard Gaussian probability measure.
